historicalResolvedFindings.originalEvidence: The English summary says the container cannot write to anything outside the listed mounts. Compose has no read_only root filesystem and the image uses a writable adedev home and temporary paths. The claim must be scoped to unmounted host directories, not all container paths; Codex filesystem restrictions are a separate layer.
